newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: APC eyes foreign partners for telecom unit.
newsitem.headline: APC eyes foreign partners for telecom unit.

text.p: Newly-converted holding company APC Group Inc said on Tuesday it was talking with several foreign companies for a possible buy-in into its unit Philippine Global Communications Inc (PhilCom).

"We're talking to strategic partners for PhilCom ... Our position in general is if a group can assist us develop a company, then why not?" APC chairman Jaime Gonzalez told reporters after the firm's annual shareholders' meeting.
APC acquired a 40 percent stake in PhilCom last year, and is set to exercise its right to buy another 22 percent within the year.
Gonzalez said he was willing to dilute its holdings in PhilCom, one of the three major investments of APC since it decided to shift from its unprofitable oil exploration activities.
"Dilution is just a concept. What is more important is the value of your holdings. It's no big deal," he said, when asked whether APC is willing to take a minority position.
Gonzalez declined to say how soon an agreement could be forged.
"We would like to close something as soon as possible, but we want it on the terms that are acceptable to us, and that's a good deal for the investors. That's easier said than done," he added.
